chimes_client_phantom_scan_skip.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Level.getEntitiesOfClass (m_45976_) call of WindChimeBE.tick and WindBellBE.tick: on a client level, while no client-side Phantom can have a target, the search is marked UNUSED (vanilla_entity_walk_skip leaves out its walk; the loop finds nothing to act on, as with the full list). @Inject RETURN (priority 2000) of Mob.setTarget reads the target field: a client-side Phantom with a target ends the skip for the session. @Inject RETURN of Phantom.<init>: a phantom class that overrides getTarget ends it. The group's mixin plugin (ChimesPlugin) checks the merged Mob class: getTarget is the plain field read and only setTarget (or handlers only setTarget calls) writes the field; at run time the field must still be private and no other mod's mixin of priority 2000 or more may have been applied to Mob after that check. Runtime flag chimesClientPhantomScanSkip, shadow chimesClientPhantomScanSkip.shadow. Helpers bons.furious.patch.chimes_coo49.ChimesScans, ChimesPlugin.

chimes_phantom_scan_interval.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Level.getEntitiesOfClass (m_45976_) call of WindChimeBE.tick and WindBellBE.tick: on a server level the search runs only when (game time + an offset from the block position) is a multiple of N (value line, default 4 = COO's, range 1-100; 1 = every tick); on other ticks it is marked UNUSED and comes back empty. Trade-off, off by default: a phantom that picked a target inside a chime's or bell's box keeps it up to N-1 ticks longer. Value: PureConfig.intValue("chimes_phantom_scan_interval", 4, 1, 100).
